sourceText:
Homemade Italian Spaghetti Sauce
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 2, 2009 - 12:21am

Ingredients




Olive oil or sesame oil
2 pounds or more lean ground beef
1 pound Italian sausage (optional)
1 whole onion
3 cloves garlic
Italian seasoning
Fresh ground pepper
Paprika
Oregano
Bay leaves
Cayenne
Marjoram
House brandy
Beer or wine
2 jars Prego or Ragu
Lasagna noodles or Spaghetti Ricotta cheese
Thin shredded mozzarella cheese

Preparation

1 Cook 1 day in advance. Saute meat in olive oil (or sesame oil). After meat has been sauteed add your spices (onion, garlic, Italian seasoning, ground pepper, paprika, oregano, bay leaves, cayenne, marjoram, add spices to your own personal taste). 2 Let simmer. When meat starts browning use 1/4 cup of (any house brandy or liquor) let simmer for 10 minutes. Add 1/2 bottle of beer or 1/2 cup of wine. Simmer another 10 minutes, then add 1/2 cup more of your beer or wine. Next add 1 jar of Prego or Ragu sauce. Simmer 1/2 hour, then add 1 more jar and let cook for 2-3 hours. Simmer on medium heat and stir. 3 Next Day: Boil lasagna noodles in salt water with 2 tablespoons oil. Use medium-large pan. When noodles are cooked to proper softness, layer pan with thin layer of noodles. Next use a thin layer of sauce over noodles. Continue alternating sauce and noodles. Next day ricotta cheese (mixed with sauce, enough to spread). Add another layer of noodles and sauce. Top it off with mozzarella cheese on the top. Bake at 350 degrees for 1/2 hour.
